# Oncotarget

> Oncotarget is a multidisciplinary, peer-reviewed oncology journal publishing cutting-edge cancer research across therapeutic targeting, tumor biology, and drug development.

Founded by Mikhail Blagosklonny and Andrei Gudkov, Oncotarget serves as a platform for advancing cancer research through rapid publication of discoveries in molecular oncology, therapeutic strategies, and tumor biology. The journal emphasizes innovative approaches to understanding and treating cancer across multiple biological mechanisms.

## Key Topics

- Cancer research
- Therapeutic targeting
- p53 pathway
- DNA damage response
- Apoptosis
- Autophagy
- Heat shock response
- Drug repurposing
- Tumor biology
- Molecular oncology
- Mikhail Blagosklonny
- Andrei Gudkov
- Multidisciplinary approach
- PubMed indexing

## Journal Overview

- [Introducing Oncotarget](https://oncotarget.com/article/101): Journal introduction by Blagosklonny & Gudkov defining Oncotarget's cancer research mission and multidisciplinary approach to oncology
